title: Superposition of water waves (তরঙ্গের উপরিপাতন)
placement: Book pages 192–193, topic 7.2.1 তরঙ্গের বৈশিষ্ট্য, item (v) উপরিপাতন: next to চিত্র ৭.০৩ and the নিজে করো with a plate of water.
description: Superposition of water waves (page 192, topic 7.2.1 (v), চিত্র ৭.০৩) in a real ripple tank on a lab bench: a vibrator bar hung on two helical springs, with a small motor and its eccentric weight, drives two point dippers in step, and each sends circular ripples (f = 5 Hz, v = 0.25 m/s, λ = 5 cm, falling off as 1/√r) across a fine, shaded water surface whose colour follows its height, with foam beaches so nothing reflects. Two floating cork balls show the idea: ক on the centre line (crest meets crest) bobs twice as high, খ on a still line (paths differ by 1½λ: crest meets trough) stays almost still, though each wave alone makes it bob. One row of words (১ম তরঙ্গ · ২য় তরঙ্গ · দুটো একসাথে) and one numbered action walk the three cases; a live চিত্র ৭.০৩ in the panel draws, for each ball, the 1st wave, the 2nd wave and their sum against time; the result line gives the two amplitudes in a, the rule the book's sentence. Waves are drawn 6 times taller and 5 times slower (said in the panel). A quiet pause and start-over. Test tab: 5 questions (crest meets trough, which ball bobs most, one source lifted, the water does not travel, double amplitude gives four times the energy), each wrong choice with its own note. Phone-first, Bangla and English.
